verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions password protection, Netlify Advanced Security, team-based access management, and private-by-default projects. None of it shows that internal apps, deployments, or agents can be secured with an organization's own identity provider (SSO/SAML/OIDC). The Clerk template only adds end-user auth to an app you build, not org IdP access control over the Netlify platform, so it does not count.
